lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. The mid-flank region displays a matrix of approximately 5-6 visible vertical columns, with spots approximately 10-20 pixels in diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a repetitive grid structure across the mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single horizontal linear feature with a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (high luminance on top, low luminance below) extending from the post-branchial region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distribution of small, high-luminance blobs across the macro-mask of the visible dorsal fin, with higher spatial frequency observed near the anterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A non-linear, U-shaped vertical intensity band is present on the mid-lateral flank, creating a deviation in the otherwise parallel vertical grid.
